title: 第11章 九曲鳞刻可为杀人技第12章 火力才是真理
slug: 刻刀一把雕出天上白玉京
content_zh:
院落之内，风雪飘零。
伴着老人大笑声，倒是驱散了几分寒意。
风雪中，少年腰杆笔直，虽抱拳，却有傲气如寒梅般不屈冲霄。
叶金宝大笑起来：“很久没有收弟子了……你小子能仅凭老夫随手雕刻的木雕之上，感悟出‘九曲鳞刻’技艺，说明与老夫有缘。”
“也正因为如此，所以老夫主动跟二掌柜提议让你跟着我学习……”
叶金宝坦然说道。
这也解释了，为什么唐花柳突然态度温和，甚至愿意给李浪补偿的原因。
李浪闻言，面色微动，倒也猜测到几分。
他没有再拒绝叶金宝，本来成为正式雕师就要跟随一位老师学习，大抵都是铺子随机分配。
他也是运气好，能跟随叶大师，一些运气不好的，可能只会跟着一些老牌的正式雕师。
大师跟寻常的雕师，那差距可就太大了！
一旁周执事和倪嫣笑着看着这一幕。
周执事捋须笑着，却是突然一顿，眯了下眼睛：“等等……老叶，你先前没有教过这小子九曲鳞刻？”
“这小子真的是自己从你雕刻的雕像上，观摩领悟出九曲鳞刻技艺，甚至还成功入门了？”
叶金宝于风雪中摊了摊手：“对啊。”
嘶——
周执事捋须的动作一顿，忍不住揪了自己一根胡须！
这特娘是个天才啊！
叶金宝难不成捡到宝了？
不过……此子未能觉醒鬼神纹，倒也算不得宝。

叶金宝捋须轻轻笑了笑，他走到了李浪身边，伸出手，掸落李浪肩膀上的积雪，随后五指如钩，扣住肩脊。
顿时，一股温热从叶金宝的掌心中迸发，像是有一股游蛇在他体内飞速的游走窜动！
这让李浪心头不由一惊。
“放轻松，我在帮你摸骨。”
叶金宝笑道。
“身为带你的老师，除了教你雕工之外，还会传授你武道修炼。”
“因为，成为雕工铺的正式雕师，只是开始，你之后若是想要认证成为锁境雕师，必须要修武道或者鬼神纹。”
“可惜，你没有与鬼神产生共鸣，觉醒鬼神纹……”
“如今十七岁，也没了觉醒的可能性。”
叶金宝有几分惋惜。
刚好有一个对上眼的雕师徒弟，可惜……上限被锁死了。
没有觉醒鬼神纹，对雕师限制太大了，甚至，等于直接斩断了成为雕工宗师的路！
叶金宝在李浪肩膀、脊柱、臂骨等等位置，寻穴掐捏。
李浪身躯僵硬，不敢异动。
片刻后，叶金宝才是松开手。
“不过你武道根骨还是有的，虽非上品，却亦是能走一走武道。”
content_en:
In the courtyard, the wind and snow were falling.
The old man's laughter dissipated a bit of the chill.
In the wind and snow, the young man's back was straight. Although he had his fists clasped, his arrogance was as unyielding as a plum blossom soaring into the sky.
Ye Jinbao laughed loudly: "I haven't accepted a disciple for a long time... The fact that you, the boy, can comprehend the 'Nine Curved Scale Carving' technique just based on the wood carvings I carved casually shows that you are destined to me."
"It is precisely because of this that I took the initiative to propose to the second shopkeeper that you should learn from me..."
Ye Jinbao said calmly.
This also explains why Tang Hualiu suddenly had a gentle attitude and was even willing to compensate Li Lang.
Li Lang's face moved slightly when he heard this, but he guessed a bit.
He did not reject Ye Jinbao again. Originally, to become an official carver, one had to study with a teacher, which was usually randomly assigned by the shop.
He is also lucky enough to be able to follow Master Ye. Some people who are unlucky may only follow some veteran official carvers.
The gap between a master and an ordinary carver is huge!
Deacon Zhou and Ni Yan looked at this scene with smiles.
Deacon Zhou stroked his beard and smiled, but suddenly paused and narrowed his eyes: "Wait a minute...Old Ye, have you never taught this kid Jiuqu Lingke before?"
"Did this boy really observe and understand the Nine-curved scale carving technique from the statues you carved, and even successfully mastered it?"
Ye Jinbao spread his hands in the wind and snow: "That's right."
Hiss——
Deacon Zhou stopped stroking his beard and couldn't help but pull one of his beards!
This special girl is a genius!
Could it be that Ye Jinbao picked up the treasure?
However... this child's failure to awaken the ghost and god patterns is not a treasure.
Ye Jinbao stroked his beard and smiled softly. He walked to Li Lang, stretched out his hand, brushed off the snow on Li Lang's shoulder, and then clasped his shoulder with his five fingers like hooks.
Suddenly, a warmth burst out from Ye Jinbao's palm, as if a snake was moving rapidly inside his body!
This shocked Li Lang.
"Relax, I'm helping you feel your bones."
Ye Jinbao smiled.
"As your teacher, in addition to teaching you carving, I will also teach you martial arts training."
"Because becoming an official carver in the carving shop is just the beginning. If you want to be certified as a locked realm carver in the future, you must practice martial arts or ghost and god patterns."
"It's a pity that you didn't resonate with the ghosts and gods and awakened the ghosts and gods..."
"Now that I am seventeen, there is no possibility of awakening."
Ye Jinbao felt a little regretful.
There happened to be a carving master's apprentice who caught his eye, but unfortunately... the upper limit was locked.
Without the awakening of ghosts and gods, it is too restrictive for carvers, and it is even equivalent to directly cutting off the path to becoming a master carver!
Ye Jinbao found and pinched acupoints on Li Lang's shoulders, spine, arm bones, etc.
Li Lang's body was stiff and he did not dare to move.
After a while, Ye Jinbao let go of his hand.
"However, you still have some martial arts skills. Although you are not a top-level martial artist, you can still walk in the martial arts."
